eyebrow: Which endpoint is slowest right now
code:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| summarize RequestCount = count(), AvgDuration = avg(duration) by name
| order by AvgDuration desc
caption: Same summarize/order-by shape as Lesson 2 — now on application-level data.

code:
dependencies
| where success == false
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize FailureCount = count() by target, type
| order by FailureCount desc

# operation_Id links a requests row to every
# dependencies/exceptions row it triggered —
# the full story of one slow request, by one field.
caption: operation_Id is the thread that ties one request's whole story together.
